# cJSON

Unmodified cJSON 1.7.19, vendored from https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON/tree/v1.7.19
under the MIT license in LICENSE. Only cJSON.c/cJSON.h are built. Afterlight
uses locale support and limits parser nesting to 32 levels for scene files.
No dependency is downloaded at build time.
